title: Bad Prompt vs Good Prompt: Angry Customer Reply
topic: bad vs good prompt customer complaint reply
description: Same AI, same complaint. A vague prompt gives you a template with blanks; a prompt with role, facts, offer and limits gives you a reply you can send. Demo recorded in an incognito Claude chat with a made-up coffee shop.

parts.text: Same AI, same complaint. One prompt gets a template, the other gets a reply you can actually send.
Ask it vaguely: reply to this complaint, my order arrived late and the box was crushed. You get blanks to fill in, and options to pick.
parts.label: BAD PROMPT

parts.text: The fix: give it a role, the facts, what to offer, and limits.
A friendly coffee shop agent. Three days late, crushed box. A free replacement or twenty percent off. Under eighty words, and end with a question.
parts.label: GOOD PROMPT

parts.text: Now it's ready to send. No guesswork, the right offer, and a question that keeps the customer talking.
parts.label: RESULT

parts.text: Copy this pattern, and follow Prompt Minute for one AI trick a day.
